description: Draw lines between P&ID items. from and to are "TAG:PORT" or "TAG" (tag or item id; list_pid_symbols has each symbol's ports, and a bare side like 90 on a side with several ports takes the one closest to the other end, so the line runs straight when a port lines up; with no positions, the one closest to the side's centre). kind defaults to process. Signal lines come from the wiring, so draw one only for something not wired yet. A line from an item to itself or an exact duplicate is skipped.

label.description: Line number or pipe spec, e.g. 2"-CW-101-A1

name: add_process_lines
title: Add process lines
